name: Camera glide
responsibility: Glides the camera to its next place over a set time, writing the surface's transform a frame at a time
description: The camera is committed to state once, at the end, and the surface carries data-camera-motion while it flies. A gesture stops it where it is. It reads the time and its frames from the frame clock, so a replay steps it to each frame's time.

outgoing.label: the time, and a callback each frame
